**Head of Engineering Job Description:** Scope, Impact & Qualifications Reports to: CEO Level: Executive (CTO-equivalent scope) Org size: ~25 engineers Time split: 70% Product / 30% Discipline ROLE SUMMARY The Head of Engineering owns the technical outcomes of Maestro's entire product suite while also serving as the top of the engineering discipline ladder: every engineering manager and individual contributor ultimately ladders up to this role. The position deliberately splits attention: 70% product execution, 30% discipline accountability. Product delivery is the immediate, ongoing accountability; discipline work compounds over time and requires protected but smaller blocks of focus so it doesn't get crowded out by delivery pressure. This role sits at the center of Maestro's matrix structure, accountable for craft quality and standards company-wide, while ensuring embedded engineering talent on each product team is pointed at the right priorities.
  
  
**SCOPE • Org reach:** all engineering leads across all product lines report into this role (directly or via a lead layer), the senior-most engineering accountability in the company. • Product surface: full product suite, every active product line's engineering output. • Discipline surface: engineering-wide standards, tooling, and process, independent of which product team an engineer sits on. THE 70%: PRODUCT ACCOUNTABILITY The Head of Engineering is the single accountable owner for engineering execution across Maestro's product portfolio.
  
  
**What this looks like day to day:** • Partners with the engineering leads of every product line to ensure their teams are resourced against the right priorities: not just busy, but correctly sequenced. • Accountable for ensuring product strategy and roadmap direction are translated into clear, actionable engineering plans, serving as the connective layer between Product and Delivery leadership and the engineering organization, primarily through engineering leads embedded within product teams. • Accountable for applying technical judgment to turn high-level strategic priorities into concrete technical execution plans, enabling and guiding engineering leads to scope, sequence, and de-risk delivery across their product areas. • Identifies where product priorities and engineering capacity are misaligned across teams and resolves the tradeoff, including cross-team resourcing calls.
  
  

* Is the escalation point when a product line's engineering execution is off track, and is accountable for getting it back on track. Impact: Every product line ships against strategy, not just against what's easiest to build. Product and Delivery leaders have one accountable engineering partner instead of negotiating separately with each product line's lead. THE 30%: DISCIPLINE ACCOUNTABILITY The Head of Engineering owns what "good engineering" means at Maestro, independent of the product line.

**What this looks like day to day:** • Sets and maintains company-wide engineering standards (code quality, architecture principles, technical debt posture). • Owns cross-cutting technical initiatives that no single product team should solve independently, e.g. product suite services and universal QA automation. • Defines how AI tooling is used across engineering, including guardrails to ensure AI usage improves output quality and velocity rather than introducing risk or degrading craft.
  
  

* Identifies and removes friction in how engineering work gets done company-wide, streamlining processes that slow every team down in the same way. • Is the ultimate accountable owner for engineering management practice (how EMs lead, how performance is evaluated, how the craft is grown) even where day-to-day people management is embedded in product teams. Impact: Engineering quality, velocity, and management practice don't fragment by product line. An engineer's experience of "how we build software here" is consistent no matter which team they're on, and the org gets the benefits of scale (shared tooling, shared standards) instead of each team reinventing its own.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • Engineers across the organization deliver flawless technical execution that earns long-term client retention and supports growth. • Product lines are resourced against strategic priority, with tradeoffs made explicitly rather than by default. • Engineering leads across product lines operate with a shared technical bar and shared tooling. • Company-wide initiatives (QA automation, AI usage standards) ship and get adopted, not just get designed.
  
  

* Engineering management practice is consistent and healthy across the org, even though EMs are embedded in product teams day to day. QUALIFICATIONS Maestro hires for demonstrated capability, not years-of-service checkboxes. The bar below is competency-based: what someone needs to be able to do, not how long they've been doing it. Required competencies: • Has personally carried end-to-end accountability for engineering delivery across more than one product or team simultaneously: not just led a single team, but balanced competing priorities across several.
* Can translate ambiguous, high-level strategy (from product, business, or leadership) into a technical execution plan that engineers can actually build against, without needing someone else to do that translation. • Has designed or materially improved an engineering standard, process, or tooling investment that worked across teams (not a single-team fix) and can point to the before/after. • Comfortably operates in a matrixed environment, influencing and aligning engineering leads, their teams, and cross-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority. • Has hands-on technical depth sufficient to earn credibility with senior engineers and to personally evaluate technical tradeoffs.

This is not a purely managerial role. • Has direct experience managing or mentoring engineering managers, not only individual contributors. • Demonstrates sound judgment on when to standardize company-wide versus when to let product teams operate with autonomy. Strongly preferred: • Experience operating at this scope inside a company of comparable size (roughly 15 to 50 engineers), where formal process is lighter and judgment calls happen more often than policy lookups.
  
  

* Direct experience setting a company's approach to AI-assisted engineering (tooling choices, guardrails, or usage standards) rather than just using AI tools personally. • A track record of building or scaling QA automation, testing strategy, or release process across multiple teams. • Experience partnering directly with Product and Delivery leadership as a peer, not just receiving requirements from them. • Experience leading engineering for always-on, customer-facing digital products or live-service platforms, where availability, release discipline, observability, incident response, and rapid cross-functional coordination directly affect the end-user experience and client retention.

**What we're explicitly not requiring:** • A specific prior title (VP Engineering, CTO, etc.). We care about scope actually carried, not the title it came with. • A minimum years-of-experience threshold. Competency and evidence of impact matter more than tenure.
  
  

* Deep expertise in every technology in Maestro's stack. Technical judgment and the ability to evaluate tradeoffs matter more than hands-on fluency in any one language or framework.

We are seeking an IT Manager, Network Operations to lead the team responsible for the reliability, security and growth of our enterprise network. You will manage a team of network engineers, serve as the main escalation point for network reliability, infrastructure expansion and observability, and oversee the structured cabling and site deployment work that supports new and expanding locations. As Saronic scales, you will grow the function into dedicated network operations center (NOC), site deployment and integration teams, and drive our shift toward infrastructure as code and automation.
  
  
You are a hands-on leader who combines technical depth with people management and strategic planning. As Saronic grows, you will build the team, processes and standards that keep our network optimized and secure at scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop a team of network engineers ranging from associate to staff level, with full accountability for hiring, development, performance and retention.
* Set goals and expectations, run regular 1:1s and performance reviews, and make compensation and leveling recommendations.
* Build and scale the function into dedicated NOC, site deployment and integration teams, including staffing and coverage models.
* Own operational delivery and KPIs for network operations, including SLAs, uptime, change success rate and project delivery.
* Serve as the main escalation point for network incidents, reliability and infrastructure expansion, and build incident response processes with clear severity tiers, escalation paths, runbooks and post-incident reviews to reduce time to resolution.
* Own the monitoring, alerting and observability strategy, including tooling, tuning and dashboards.
* Drive adoption of infrastructure as code and automation using tools like Terraform and Ansible (or similar), including version-controlled configuration and standardized change workflows.
* Define network configuration and design standards, and coordinate change management so that changes are reviewed, approved and communicated.
* Drive the multi-quarter network roadmap, including capacity planning, lifecycle management and compliance initiatives (such as NIST 800-171, DFARS, CMMC and ITAR) where applicable.
* Plan and oversee network expansion for new and renovated sites, working with construction, facilities and contractors from design through commissioning.
* Establish structured cabling standards and develop deployment playbooks for staging, installing and validating network equipment at new sites and during technology refreshes.
* Lead network integration for acquired companies, including on-site assessments of acquired environments, sequenced integration plans, network cutovers and a reusable integration playbook.
* Manage the team budget, vendor relationships and procurement within delegated authority, including cabling contractors and telecom vendors.
* Partner with peer managers in IT, Security and Engineering, and with senior and staff engineers on technical strategy, network segmentation, access control and security policy.
* Maintain network documentation, including topology diagrams, IP schemas and operating procedures, and support audits as needed.

Position: Core Network Engineer (5G)

Location: Richardson, Texas

Reporting to: Director of Engineering

  

**Role:**

The Core Network Engineer (5G) works within the Engineering department and is responsible for the design, deployment, operation, and optimization of Limitless Mobile?s 5G core network platforms.

The role is focused on hands-on engineering execution, supporting both internal network operations and contracted wholesale customer deployments across U.S. and international environments. Innovation is delivered through practical improvements in automation, reliability, observability, and deployment efficiency rather than strategic product ownership.

  

**Tasks/Responsibilities:**

* Core Network Design, Deployment and Management
  + Design, deploy, operate, and maintain 5G Core Network (5GC) components including AMF, SMF, UPF, NRF, PCF, AUSF, and UDM across both SA and NSA deployments.
  + Deploy, manage and operate 5G core environments in high-availability and geo-redundant configurations, ensuring resilience, scalability, and service continuity.
  + Support inter-PLMN connectivity including roaming, SEPP, and secure interconnect architectures.
  + Support mediation requirements for billing / charging and performance statistics on 5G core platform.
  + Perform end-to-end call-flow debugging and protocol-level troubleshooting across N1, N2, N3, N4, N6, N10, N11, and N12 interfaces.
  + Implement and support network slicing, policy control, and service function chaining.
  + Ensure compliance with relevant 3GPP specifications, security requirements, and interface protocols (e.g. HTTP/2, PFCP, SCTP).
  + Collaborate with RAN and infrastructure teams to support lab test-cells, and limited production radio deployments where required.
  + Integrate, harden, and operate both vendor-supplied and open-source 5G core solutions (e.g. Open5GS, free5GC, Magma) in test, pre-production, and production environments.
  + Contribute fixes, enhancements, and operational tooling where appropriate to support production stability and maintainability.
  + Use automation to reduce mean time to repair (MTTR), improve deployment repeatability, and increase operational visibility.
  + Develop and maintain custom scripts and tooling (e.g. Python, Bash, Go) to automate deployment, configuration, testing, monitoring, and fault analysis.

* Pre-Sales
  + Provide technical input and peer review to pre-sales and solution architecture activities, validating feasibility, integration complexity, and operational impact.
  + Contribute implementation-level considerations and constraints to High-Level Design (HLD) documentation produced by Solution Architects.

* Projects
  + Execute assigned technical workstreams within contracted wholesale customer projects, including deployment, integration, testing, and handover to operations.
  + Work under the direction of the Director of Engineering and in coordination with Solution Architects and Project Manager to deliver agreed technical outcomes.

* Operations
  + Provide Tier-3 technical support to the Network Operations Centre (NOC) for live network incidents affecting wholesale and internal services.
  + Participate in escalation and support on-call rotations as required.
  + Conduct root-cause analysis, document findings, and implement corrective and preventative actions.

* Skills Development
  + Continuously develop technical expertise across core network functions, infrastructure platforms, and emerging 3GPP features relevant to Limitless Mobile?s network roadmap.

**Measurement:**

* Performance will be assessed based on a combination of delivery effectiveness, operational stability, incident resolution time, change success rate, and successful deployment of wholesale customer solutions.

**Desired Expertise & Experience:**

* Bachelor?s or Master?s degree in computer science or engineering.
* Minimum of 5-8 years working in the telecommunications industry designing, integrating and managing mobile core network propositions for e.g. a Network Equipment Provider or carrier / Mobile Network Operator (MNO).
* Deep understanding of 5G Core architecture (SA/NSA), 3GPP specs, and control/user plane functions.
* Experience with open source 5G cores like Open5GS, free5GC, or Magma.
* Experience with Mongo database for opensource 5G solutions is a plus.
* Programming in at least one of the C++, Python, Golang, Bash, or equivalent languages.
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), Git, and CI/CD tools.
* Hands-on experience with Wireshark, PCAP analysis, and log-level debugging.

* Minimum of five years of systems integration, management and/or technical support of 4G / LTE and 5G mobile core network components.
* In-depth knowledge of mobile voice and data core network architecture (including MNO and MVNO / MVNE infrastructure architecture) as well as network topology, including ability to describe the key elements of a mobile network and understand how the components function and interact as well as how mobile calls are made and received and how mobile data sessions work both in VoLTE and VoNR environments.
* Understanding of Packet Switched network elements, interfaces and messaging for 4G / LTE networks, including IMS architectures and PCRF.
* Understanding of Voice SIP / RTP, ISUP and voice convergence technologies, including IMS (including VoLTE and VoWiFi).
* Understanding of RADIUS and Diameter for both signaling and charging scenarios.
* Experience of capacity management and dimensioning of mobile core elements.
* Familiarity with LI (Lawful Intercept), E911 and CALEA requirements.
* Familiarity with IMS and VoNR architecture.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and operationalizing technically robust mobile core network solutions aligned with customer, regulatory, and operational requirements.

**Desired Personality:**

* Entrepreneurial and proactive and accountable self-starter, comfortable with taking ownership of complex technical problems and hunger to make a difference as well as strong performance and results orientation.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced start-up environment, managing multiple projects and deadlines in parallel with ability to recognise and adjust priorities as required.
* Detail-oriented, methodical, and well organised yet able to demonstrate a high degree of flexibility and adaptability.
* Able to operate calmly and methodically in live-network and incident-driven environments.
* Ability to work effectively both independently as well as in a team.
* Effective communicator with strong documentation discipline and the ability to collaborate across engineering and operations teams.
* Positive and constructive personality, including willingness to go beyond the call-of-duty to ensure successful and on-time delivery of the projects.

**Residence Requirement:**

* Candidate must have authorization to work in the US.

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network, with a mission to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will connect people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.  
  
The Leo NOC and Leo Incident Management (LIM) Operations Tooling team builds the products that run the Leo network day to day. Our tools are used by the Network Operations Center, Call Leaders, and service teams across Networking, Commerce, and Satellite Operations to see the health of the network, catch problems before customers do, coordinate fast when something goes wrong, and automate the work that slows operators down.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate these tools. You will turn health signals and network telemetry into operator workflows and automation, proactive health and early warning features, NOC dashboards and runbook automation, alarm correlation and noise reduction, incident management and escalation tooling, and the post-event systems that feed every lesson back into better detection. You will work closely with the product manager, operators, and Call Leaders who use your tools every day, and you will own what you build from design through production.
  
  
Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, build, and operate scalable, highly available services and tools that power network operations and incident management for Amazon Leo.
* Build proactive health capabilities, including anomaly and trend detection, early warning features, and proactive investigation workflows that help operators act before customers are affected.
* Build alarm correlation and deduplication systems so responders see one problem instead of hundreds of alerts.
* Build NOC dashboards and operator workflows that bring health, customer impact, affected components, and ongoing events into one view.
* Build self-service tooling that lets service teams onboard and manage their own health signals, alarms, and runbooks.
* Automate runbook steps, data collection, and repetitive operational tasks so operators spend their time on judgment, not mechanics.
* Integrate with observability, telemetry, ticketing, paging, and communication systems across Amazon Leo, including the network observability platform.
* Apply automation, machine learning, and generative AI to triage, event summarization, timeline drafting, and correlation where it measurably improves outcomes.
* Design systems that stay available when the network they serve is degraded, since operators need these tools most during an outage.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, operational readiness, and on-call support.
* Mentor other engineers and contribute to a culture of high-quality, secure, and maintainable software.

  
A day in the life  
You might start the day with feedback from the NOC on a dashboard you shipped last week and fix a workflow that slowed operators down during an overnight event. Midday, you could be designing a correlation service that groups alarms from many services into a single event, or building the escalation engine that pages the right leader when an event has been open too long. In the afternoon you might pair with the product manager on a self-service onboarding flow, review code, and prototype an AI-drafted event summary for Call Leaders. Your work shows up every time an issue is caught earlier, resolved faster, or never happens at all.  
  
About the team  
The Leo NOC and LIM Operations Tooling team builds the operational products that keep a global space and terrestrial telecom network healthy and its operations efficient. We sit next to the people who use our tools, the Network Operations Center and the Incident Management Team. We measure success by how much faster, quieter, and more automated operations become as the network scales toward and beyond general availability.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

The Technical Program Manager administers the qualification and validation of new products, and of retrofits and engineering changes to existing parts, for use in large-scale data center environments. The program spans inside plant (ISP) and outside plant (OSP) optical fiber cable, connectivity, and pathway products from candidate identification through validated, released configuration. The position owns the technical content of the program: product selection and evaluation criteria, test methodology, acceptance limits, measurement integrity, and the qualification record that supports product approval and release. The Technical Program Manager serves as the technical interface between design engineering, construction and installation crews, component manufacturers, and test equipment suppliers, and is accountable for validated, documented, and field-reproducible connectivity products on schedule.

* **Validation Program Planning and Execution:** Develop and own integrated validation program plans covering both new product introduction and retrofits or engineering changes to existing parts — qualification sequence, entry and exit criteria, material and laboratory dependencies, and decision gates — holding the critical path and driving programs to documented closure.

* **~20%** Solution enablement, technical coordination, and early‑stage support

**If you’re the person people turn to when a technical problem gets messy and nobody is sure what happens next, we’d like to meet you.**

At CustomCommerce, we build custom software, AI agents, and automations that help businesses solve practical problems. We build in short, iterative cycles so clients can see progress and shape the solution along the way. Weekly demos give clients a chance to see what’s ready, test improvements in their day-to-day workflows, and tell us what needs refining. This iterative approach delivers usable capabilities sooner, helps us refine solutions around how clients actually work, and keeps their investment focused on the priorities that create the most value for their business.

We are looking for someone who can make that process work well for everyone. You might start the day helping a client explain why an AI agent is routing inquiries incorrectly, then turn that conversation into a clear issue engineering can investigate. Later, you might walk another client through a demo and get a decision that keeps their project moving. The common thread is bringing clarity to technical work and making sure people follow through. If you enjoy solving problems and want to help shape how solutions work in practice, this role gives you room to do that.

**The Role**

Once a deal is signed, you will become the client’s primary point of contact. You will lead the handoff from sales, connect the client with engineering through development, testing, and launch, and stay involved afterward to support adoption and resolve issues.

You will manage execution against the agreed project plan. You will keep deliverables moving, coordinate client decisions and approvals, and flag risks early. Engineering owns technical estimates and decisions about how the solution is built. When a client asks for work outside the agreed scope, you will clarify what they need, bring in leadership to assess the request, and keep the client informed about next steps.

**What You will Do**

* **Make the handoff from sales feel seamless.** Get up to speed on what was sold, why the client needs it, and what success looks like. Confirm expectations and immediate next steps at kickoff.
* **Keep multiple projects moving.** Track deliverables, deadlines, dependencies, and commitments on both sides. Follow up on open items and bring in the right people when a milestone is at risk.
* **Give clients a clear view of progress.** Run check-ins and send clear updates so clients know what’s ready, what’s in progress, and where their input or approval is needed.
* **Use weekly demos to turn client feedback into clear next steps.** Help clients prepare to test what’s ready, capture feedback and decisions during demos, and bring unresolved questions, client priorities, and dependencies into monthly planning.
* **Turn client feedback into work engineering can act on.** Ask questions to understand what the client is trying to accomplish. Document the workflow, expected behavior, and how the client will confirm the solution meets their needs.
* **Investigate issues and follow through.** Gather examples, reproduce the problem when possible, and check whether it stems from how the solution is used, configured, or behaving. Give engineering enough context to investigate and keep the client updated through resolution.
* **Coordinate testing and launch.** Help clients test real scenarios, track fixes and approvals, and confirm they’re ready to use the solution in their day-to-day work.
* **Help deliver client value after launch.** Help clients get comfortable with the solution, coordinate ongoing support, and surface opportunities for follow-on work when they reflect a real business need.

**What You Bring**

* **Clear written and verbal communication.** You can lead a client call, explain a technical issue in plain language, and write a recap that makes decisions and next steps easy to find.
* **Strong organization across competing priorities.** You can manage several active client engagements and keep track of who owns each next step, when it’s due, and what’s at risk.
* **Technical curiosity and practical troubleshooting skills.** You ask focused questions, test possible causes, and know when to bring in a specialist. You don’t need to write code.
* **Good judgment when things change.** You can handle a frustrated client, an unclear request, or a slipping deliverable calmly. You set realistic expectations and follow through.
* **Experience helping customers or business users solve technical problems.** Technical support, help desk, business analysis, software implementation, and other hands-on technology roles are all relevant. If you’ve been the person who keeps users informed, brings the right people together, and sees issues through, we’d like to hear from you. A previous Customer Success Manager title isn’t required.

**Experience That Would Be a Plus**

* A strong interest in AI or hands-on experience experimenting with AI agents, AI tools, or workflow automation. Personal projects count, too.
* Experience supporting custom software, SaaS products, integrations, or technology implementations.
* Experience gathering requirements, documenting workflows, coordinating user testing, or helping teams adopt a new system.

### **Brief Job Description**

The Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) is seeking qualified candidates for a **Director II – Delivery & Operations** position. This role performs highly complex (senior‑level) managerial work focused on maturing and stabilizing delivery governance by enabling teams to deliver predictably, protecting stakeholders from unnecessary disruption, and reinforcing shared accountability.

The Director II works under minimal supervision with extensive latitude for independent judgment and owns domain‑level intake, prioritization, delivery sequencing, and release readiness decisions across the delivery & operation functions. This position is specifically responsible for standardizing delivery processes across multiple teams, addressing inconsistent intake, discovery, and prioritization practices, and improving predictability and confidence for our stakeholders.

This role practices **servant leadership** by removing obstacles, reinforcing clear governance, and enabling teams and stakeholders to operate with confidence and predictability. This role is intentionally designed to begin as an **enabling leader**, establishing consistent delivery flow, governance discipline, and shared operating practices across teams with differing maturity levels. As delivery flow becomes established and reliable, the role transitions to a more **defensive posture**, protecting stable operations and clean releases while maintaining a continuous‑improvement mindset focused on quality, risk management, and stakeholder trust.

### **Essential Job Functions (EJFs)**

#### **Delivery Governance & Standardization (30%)**

* Owns and enforces a single, standardized intake and delivery governance model that enables teams to focus on delivery while reducing ambiguity and rework.
* Addresses and corrects inconsistent intake, prioritization, and sequencing practices.
* Aligns delivery governance between teams with differing maturity levels, leveraging proven practices where performance is stronger.
* Prevents parallel, exception‑based, or ad‑hoc delivery paths that reduce predictability.

**Job Description:**  

* Lead the development, implementation, and ongoing evaluation of the organization’s QAPI program across skilled nursing operations.
* Monitor organizational and facility-level quality indicators and identify trends, outliers, and emerging areas of concern.
* Assist leaders in identifying opportunities for Performance Improvement Projects (PIPs) based on data, regulatory findings, resident feedback, and operational performance.

* Maintain QAPI dashboards, scorecards, project trackers, and supporting documentation.
* Monitor completion and effectiveness of corrective action plans and improvement initiatives.
* Collect, validate, analyze, and interpret clinical, quality, operational, and resident experience data.
* Develop routine and ad hoc reports that clearly communicate performance, trends, and areas requiring leadership attention.
* Establish appropriate baseline measures and monitor progress against internal goals and external benchmarks.

* Support monitoring of quality measures and other applicable clinical and regulatory performance indicators.

* Support preparation of data and documentation for Quality Assurance Committee meetings, leadership reviews, surveys, and other regulatory activities.
* Maintain organized documentation demonstrating QAPI activity, interventions, monitoring, and sustained improvement.
* Analyze resident and family satisfaction, complaints, grievances, and other experience-related data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
* Integrate resident experience information with clinical and operational data to provide a more comprehensive view of organizational performance.
* Support development and monitoring of annual organizational quality goals and associated performance metrics.

* Assist facility leaders in understanding and appropriately interpreting performance data.
* Provide education and technical support related to QAPI tools, measurement methodologies, dashboards, and performance improvement processes.
* Promote data-driven decision-making and a culture focused on measurable, sustainable improvement.

### **Job Specific Context**

Background: UNMAS Syria Programme

Operating under the mandate of Security Council resolution 2165 (renewed in 2017 with SCR 2393), UNMAS deployed to Syria at the request of the Deputy Regional Humanitarian Coordinator in August 2015 and subsequently activated the Mine Action Sub Sector under the Protection Sector to address the impact of explosive hazards within Syria. UNMAS acted as the lead agency for the Mine Action Sub sector for Syria. Established in Damascus since 2018, following the signature of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Syrian Arab Republic, UNMAS strives to expand humanitarian mine action in Syria, with the aim of responding to high humanitarian needs. This includes humanitarian mine action activities prioritized in the Humanitarian Response Plan (HRP) for Syria: risk education, victim assistance, survey and clearance.

The conflict in Syria has been characterized by the extensive use of explosive weapons, which resulted in large-scale explosive hazard contamination, with the presence of diversified types of ordnances. According to the Syrian Arab Republic Humanitarian Needs Response Plan(HNRP) 2026, over 14.3 million Syrians are estimated to be at risk of explosive ordnance (EO) contamination; men, women, and children are exposed to the threat of grave injuries and death on a daily basis.

Mitigating EO risks and supporting survivors are a key priority given the scale of EO contamination with 2335 civilian casualties recorded between December 2024 and June 2026.

UNMAS play a central role in reducing harm through non-technical survey, EO disposal and clearance, inclusive risk education integrated with critical services such as education, agriculture, and cash/livelihoods, and sensitive community engagement, while facilitating referrals to survey and clearance actors where feasible.

* Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with shifting priorities and timelines

* Good comprehension of continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD) concepts a plus

* Expertise in enterprise cloud solutions like Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), containers, Kubernetes, cloud management, and IT automation

* Experience deploying applications in cloud environments
* Familiarity with source code management tools like Git or SVN
* Prior experience in a technical leadership or mentorship role

* Ability to travel for customer visits and events within the region

* Demonstrate expertise by delivering whitepapers and conference speeches; share knowledge with your team members to allow them to learn from your work.

* 5+ years of experience as a sales engineer, consultant, solutions architect, or a relevant role.
* Knowledge of Linux (preferably Red Hat Enterprise Linux), Red Hat Satellite, Red Hat Insights, or other related technologies.

* Knowledge of public clouds, including AWS and GCP.
* Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to present and have technical and business discussions with C-level executives.
* Willingness to travel up to 50%.

The Red Hat Services team is looking for a Senior Consultant to implement practical AI solutions that directly solve client challenges using Red Hat OpenShift and Red Hat AI. In this role, you are hands-on throughout technical deployments on engagements that produce tangible outcomes—such as cost-optimized inference, model services with integrated chargeback, or operationalized AI agents. You will work closely with customer teams to turn defined goals and delivery dates into fully landed, functional implementations. To help customer platform teams sustain success long after delivery, you will establish reusable assets on every engagement, including reference architectures, runbooks, and harnesses.
  
  
You will act as a key advocate for Red Hat AI solutions, combining technical experience with strong interpersonal skills to solve client problems and scale enterprise AI deployments. Ideal candidates combine a strong background in open-source AI frameworks with a solid grasp of business processes.
  
  
We seek people excited about working with us and growing their careers at Red Hat. We want to be transparent about what would make you most successful in the role, and if you are excited by reading the job description and feel you are suitable for the part, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
This position requires candidates to work on-site with clients throughout specified locations, so a willingness to travel to customer locations for about 30-40 weeks per year throughout North America is required. Successful applicants must reside in a state where Red Hat is registered to do business and hold an Active Top Secret Clearance.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Red Hat customers aim to personalize AI across three core areas: their models, their data, and their operational AI. Your responsibilities align directly with these key pillars:
  
  

* Guide customers in implementing scalable, production-ready AI solutions using Red Hat OpenShift and Red Hat AI.
* Deploy, optimize, and serve AI models (vLLM, KServe, model registries, pipelines) and baseline inference costs using benchmarking tools and recipe-based optimization.

* Work with Sales on customer inquiries, presentations, and demos.

* *Create intuitive visualizations and narratives that allow leaders to understand performance, isolate exceptions, and move from insight to action.*

* *Enable self-service analytics by establishing trusted definitions, useful drilldowns, documentation, and appropriate user guidance.*

* *Present analysis and recommendations with confidence, adjusting the level of detail for technical, operational, and executive audiences.*

* *Maintain awareness of relevant analytical tools, methods, and industry practices and apply them pragmatically based on business value and solution maturity.*

* **Manage governance, risk, and performance:** Lead cross-functional governance, resolve escalations, and manage risks involving billing, ordering, revenue, service continuity, operational readiness, customer migration, and escalation resolution. The Sr. Partner Sales Executive (SPSE) is a revenue-driving role focused on growing T-Mobile's business through named Technology Advisors (TAs). The SPSE is accountable for a portfolio of 75+ TAs and owns an assigned annual revenue quota that contributes to the channel's multimillion-dollar annual target. The SPSE owns the performance of an assigned TA portfolio by setting portfolio strategy and executing business plans specifically engineered to accelerate revenue, arming TAs with T-Mobile market insights and proven demand-gen strategies that convert into closed bookings, and clearing internal friction points that slow down the sales cycle by influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority. As the internal advocate for TAs, the SPSE ensures nothing stands between a TA and a signed deal. The SPSE is also responsible for expanding the revenue base itself by proactively identifying and activating new TAs to fill territory gaps and add incremental production to the book.

**Job Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Revenue Delivery & Partner Growth: Own and deliver the portfolio's annual revenue target. Partner with priority TAs on a short, joint plan tied to a shared value proposition, then drive that plan into the field by activating TAs on live opportunities, removing obstacles to close, and focusing training, resources, and MDF where expected return is highest.
* Activate New Agents: Sell the value of a T-Mobile partnership to agents not currently doing business with T-Mobile, with the goal of converting them into producing partners. Identify and prospect targets, manage them through a defined pipeline from first outreach to signed agreement and first closed deal, and own new-agent activation and first-year production goals. Build the new-agent pipeline proactively, using Technology Services Distributor (TSD) relationships, market intelligence, and territory gaps, to add incremental revenue and meet or exceed portfolio revenue targets.

Track partner activity and participation rates, identify dormant or under-engaged TAs, and execute targeted re-engagement plans to convert inactive partners into active pipeline contributors.

* Pipeline & Forecast Management: Manage and optimize the sales pipeline for new and renewal business to ensure accurate forecasting of indirect business. Support TAs in building and managing their sales pipeline efficiently.
* Partner Segmentation & Territory Planning: Segment the 75+ TA portfolio to identify MVP and high-potential TAs and set a territory management plan that drives efficiency and revenue, determining which TAs receive priority investment and where coverage gaps call for new-agent activation.
* Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis: Gather and analyze market trends and competitive dynamics to inform portfolio strategy and provide TAs with actionable intelligence. Share insights to help them adjust strategies and remain competitive, and escalate channel-level insights that can shape T-Mobile's indirect programs, incentives, or offers.
* Advocate for TAs: Serve as the primary point of contact, senior escalation point, and advocate for TAs within T-Mobile. The Sr. Strategy and Programs Manager, FWA HSI Local Marketing Activation is the connection between FWA High Speed Internet local marketing strategy and what happens in market. This role owns how local marketing gets activated for FWA HSI: partnering with the HSI acquisition team to identify opportunities and priorities, deciding where, why, and how to activate, designing the programs that do it, and enabling the field to run those programs with confidence.  
  
The role works where network capacity and demand are out of balance. That includes High Supply and Low Demand markets, where available capacity isn’t converting into activations, and markets where churn and disconnects are eroding growth. This person turns market-level data into targeted local programs, runs them, measures them, and scales what works.  
  
This is not a project coordinator role. This person builds the activation programs, owns their delivery, and is accountable for whether they drive new accounts and retention in market.  
  
This is a remote role. Travel expectation is up to 30% nationally, covering market visits, National Marketing engagements, planning sessions, and team collaboration. The best activation programs are designed by people who spend time in the markets they are building.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

**Activation Strategy & Program Design**

* Own the activation approach. Develop the framework for how FWA HSI local marketing gets activated: which markets, which audiences, which tactics, in what sequence, and what principles guide local decisions.
* Lead High Supply and Low Demand programs. Combine network capacity data with local marketing levers to build programs that convert available capacity into activation and define when a geography qualifies.
* Build complete program designs. Every program should have a clear objective, target audience, channel mix, offer and messaging direction, timeline, budget, and success metric, with rationale for each choice.
* Develop retention-oriented programs. Partner with the disconnect and churn effort to design local programs that reduce HSI churn, not just drive new orders.
* Close the gaps. Identify moments where the organization lacks a proven tactic or a defined approach for FWA HSI, and build the solution instead of flagging it for someone else.

**Program Execution & Field Enablement**

* Run the programs. Own program management from design through launch and close-out: timelines, dependencies, vendors, budgets, and cross-functional deliverables.
* Enable the field. Give the field everything it needs to execute: program briefs, targeting lists, messaging guidance, creative assets, and clear success criteria.
* Sequence the rollout. Pilot first, then scale in phases, tied to the commercial calendar and to the team’s 2027 expansion into HSI.
* Make it stick. Partner with the Hyperlocal Playbook Manager so proven programs are captured in the playbook as operating standards.

**Measurement & Test-and-Learn**

* Design the tests. Build test-and-control structures for local programs so the team can separate real lift from noise.
* Target with data. Use propensity and segmentation analysis to choose and size markets and opportunity.
* Report what works. Produce clear readouts on incremental new accounts, churn impact, cost per acquisition, and program ROI, and recommend scale, adjust, or stop.
* Close the loop. Run a retrospective at the end of each program and each quarter: what the program produced, where execution diverged from the plan, and what changes next.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with National Marketing. Pull national campaigns, brand guardrails, and creative into field-ready formats, and push field learnings back up so what gets built centrally serves local needs.
* Partner with HSI Acquisition team to identify commercial opportunities and priorities for hyperlocal marketing campaigns
* Partner with Network and Capacity Planning. Get timely, usable capacity data so programs target the right markets at the right time.
* Partner with Analytics and Sales Operations. Align on data, measurement, and incentives so programs are measurable and the frontline is incented to action off of them.
* Coordinate with the Fiber team. Manage the places where FWA and fiber overlap, including footprint eligibility changes and creating an ecosystem accounting for customer moves from HSI to fiber.
* Steward the brand. Ensure local activity stays within T-Mobile brand guardrails while remaining locally effective.

**Quarterly Planning & Field Intelligence**

* Contribute to the planning cycle. Translate commercial targets, capacity conditions, and national priorities into a 90-day activation program plan with market-by-market priorities.
* Synthesize the signal. Aggregate market observations, competitive activity, and program performance into insights that inform local decisions and national direction.
* Find the pattern. Identify which market conditions, audiences, and tactic combinations are producing results and what the team should do more of.
* Brief leadership. Produce a regular update for the Sr. Manager and Director on what’s working, what isn’t, and what the field needs.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Bachelor's Degree and 7 years of related work experience, or a combination of education and experience deemed equivalent
* 7-10 years in marketing strategy, field marketing, growth marketing, or program management, with demonstrated ownership of programs from design through measurement.
* Strong analytical skills, including campaign measurement, segmentation, and test-and-control design.
* Experience managing complex, cross-functional programs with many stakeholders and no direct authority.
* Experience translating strategy into field-executable programs that people actually use.
* Strong written and verbal communicator who can brief the field, partner teams, and senior leaders.
* Comfortable operating without complete information and adjusting quickly when results come in.
* Experience in telecom, broadband, or a brand with a significant field or local marketing component preferred
* Background managing the interface between a national marketing organization and a distributed field team preferred
* Familiarity with hyperlocal marketing channels — OOH, community partnerships, ambassador programs, geo-targeted digital preferred
* Experience developing audience segmentation frameworks and channel-audience matching strategies preferred
* Background in capability building — has developed training, toolkits, or frameworks adopted by a field team preferred
* At least 18 years of age
* Legally authorized to work in the United States

**Job Summary**

FreeWheel is looking for a Product Manager to support and help deliver a market-informed roadmap and strategy for a wide array of buy-side capabilities, with a focus on our core ad serving application capabilities. You'll immerse yourself in the Connected TV (CTV) market to help make us the best platform in the world to buy CTV advertising. Working alongside colleagues throughout Comcast Advertising and FreeWheel, you'll help deliver innovative products that help customers better deliver their ads to the right audiences worldwide.

**Job Description**

This role will work on the Buyer Cloud (fka Beeswax) buying platform within the FreeWheel product suite. Buyer Cloud's driving vision is to be the best platform in the world for buying CTV advertising. Buyer Cloud is an easy-to-use, massively scaled, high-availability and highly flexible platform used by buyers worldwide. We offer our customers the most extensible and transparent advertising platform in the world and process millions of transactions per second.

We are looking for a Product Manager to support the development and delivery of a market-informed roadmap and strategy for a wide array of buy-side capabilities. You'll immerse yourself in the Connected TV market to help make us the best platform in the world to buy CTV advertising.

**What You'll Do:**

* Support the conception, design, and implementation of capabilities that offer our customers unique opportunities to buy CTV advertising, with a particular emphasis on ad serving, filtering, targeting, and so on. You’ll be working on the most core and important parts of a Demand Side Platform (DSP) ad delivery.
* Collaborate closely with our engineering team to guide products to launch and beyond
* Work with stakeholders, internal and external, to help drive high-quality decisions and outcomes
* Help showcase product launches in release trainings, client emails, and company webinars

**Who You Are:**

Xumo, a joint venture between Comcast and Charter Communications, was formed to develop and offer a next-generation streaming platform for the entire entertainment industry. The company consists of three primary lines of business: Xumo devices, Xumo Play, and Xumo Enterprise. Powered by Comcast’s global entertainment platform, Xumo devices feature a world-class user interface with universal voice search capabilities, making it easy for consumers to find and enjoy their favorite streaming content. **Job Summary**
The Sr. Manager, Xumo Editorial Platform Operations leads the day-to-day operational execution of editorial merchandising experiences across Xumo platforms. This role manages a small team of operations and production professionals responsible for translating editorial and business strategy into high-quality, customer-facing experiences through CMS programming, targeting, testing, creative production, QA and launch execution. The Sr. Manager serves as a critical connection point between Editorial Merchandising, Product, Engineering, Design and partner teams, ensuring new experiences and capabilities are operationally ready, accurately implemented and successfully launched. The role requires a strong combination of people leadership, digital production expertise, operational discipline and hands-on familiarity with content management and experimentation tools.
  
  
**Job Description**
Team Leadership & Operations
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop a small team responsible for editorial platform operations and production.
* Establish effective workflows, operating procedures, prioritization models and quality standards that enable the team to execute efficiently at scale.
* Manage day-to-day workload and resources across ongoing programming, launches, product initiatives and high-priority business needs.
* Partner closely with Editorial Merchandising leadership to translate editorial, audience and inventory strategies into executable platform experiences.

CMS Programming & Experience Management
  
  

* Own operational programming and publishing across Xumo CMS and merchandising tools.
* Build, schedule and maintain editorial experiences, menus, collections and other content surfaces.
* Oversee the buildout and ongoing management of new menus, navigation experiences and merchandising placements.
* Ensure customer-facing experiences are accurate, timely and consistent across supported Xumo devices and platforms.

Product Features & Launch Readiness
  
  

* Partner with Product, Engineering and Editorial teams to test and operationalize new platform functionality and features.
* Lead UAT, operational readiness and rollout activities for new tools, capabilities and customer experiences.
* Identify operational requirements and potential issues prior to launch and develop repeatable processes for supporting new functionality after release.
* Represent Editorial Operations in product-development conversations to ensure tooling and workflows meet programming and production needs.

Experimentation, Targeting & Optimization
  
  

* Execute A/B tests and other editorial experiments in partnership with Editorial, Product and Analytics teams.
* Implement audience targeting and segmentation strategies across supported platform tools.
* Ensure experiments are configured correctly, appropriately QA'd and operationally scalable.
* Apply learnings from testing and platform performance to improve execution and inform future workflows.

Creative Production
  
  

* Oversee production and delivery of editorial imagery and other creative assets required for on-platform experiences.
* Manage production workflows, specifications, deadlines and quality standards.
* Coordinate with internal creative resources and partners to ensure assets are delivered accurately and on schedule.

Quality Assurance
  
  

* Establish and maintain rigorous QA standards across the editorial production lifecycle.
* Oversee copyediting and content QA for customer-facing editorial experiences.
* Validate programming and configurations within CMS and campaign tools.
* Conduct on-device and on-screen QA to ensure the final customer experience matches editorial and product intent.
* Identify recurring defects or workflow issues and establish processes, documentation and automation to reduce errors.

* Experience supporting new product features from testing and UAT through launch and ongoing operations.
* Strong understanding of QA methodologies, including editorial, functional and customer-experience QA.

**The Role**
------------

We have an immediate opening for **Field Technician I** **.** Responsible for asset management: processes deliveries and replenishes consumables as well as coordinates shipping and receiving of materials. Maintains tools, test sets, and electronic equipment including, but not limited to: fiber optic transmission equipment, lightwave multiplexing equipment, AC and DC power equipment. Assists in installs, provisions, tests, and maintains DS0 thru OC192 services. May install and test transmission/switching equipment. Troubleshoots network equipment, removes and replaces defective modules, tracks spares and ensures repair. Monitors/locates route and assists in executing restoration in the event of a service interruption, proactively responds to potential problem areas in order to ensure integrity of the network. Responsible for learning all of the systems and applications required to perform the job function adequately. Updates installation records, enters appropriate detailed log information on trouble tickets for reference, and provides reports to others on status updates and issues related to assignments. Performs preventive/scheduled maintenance and inspections on equipment and on the critical infrastructure including, but not limited to: HVAC systems, high-voltage electrical systems, DC Power Plants

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Troubleshoots network equipment, removes/replaces defective equipment, and works with appropriate resources to isolate and ultimately restore network. Proactively identify potential problem areas to ensure integrity of the network and company.
* Assists in the installation/change/decommission and testing of Next Generation technologies such as Edge Compute, Wavelength, Fiber Optic transport, Ethernet, SONET and IP network layers for all available bandwidths offered. May install and test network and customer premise equipment (CPE) including installation and delivery of end user services.
* Utilizes industry standard software and hardware tools to accurately locate, mark, and protect underground outside plant facilities.
* AC Power (on limited basis).
* DC power installs including tertiary and BDCBB.
* Responsible for asset management processes and replenishment of on-site/truck materials. Coordinates shipping and receiving of company and customer materials. Maintains tools, test sets, and all network equipment.
* Performs level 1 preventive scheduled maintenance and inspections on network and critical infrastructure equipment including HVAC systems, high-voltage electrical systems, and DC power plants.
* With the aid of training and coaching, responsible for learning Lumen trouble ticket, provisioning, time tracking, and materials systems and applications required to perform the job function effectively. Update/report inventory records changes, complete transactional updates within systems to show appropriate activities by job type, enter appropriate time log, and responsive to requests for information/escalations. Regularly provides status updates and reports problem situations related to assignments to management.
* Objectively evaluate, via provided reports/tools, individual performance in respect to area or national performance objectives. With support of manager, ability to identify areas of improvement as applicable.
* Perform other duties assigned by management team.
* Understands that basics of installation/change/decommissioning/testing of transport, Ethernet, SONET and IP network layers for all available bandwidths offered.

**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------

* High School Diploma or GED or up to 2 years of relevant job experience including 1+ years network monitoring, installation, or maintenance/repair.
* Entry-level technician with experience and/or knowledge of at least one of the four major technician disciplines: Transmission (DS1/DS3/SONET), Switching (circuit-switching/SS7), TCP/IP (routers/higher-layer protocols), and Outside Plant (Fiber locating, OTDR, Mass Fusion Splicing, etc.).
* Have knowledge of locating fiber optic cable, right-of-way, and As-Builts.
* Must maintain site security and cleanliness.
* Must have PC skills and be well versed in Microsoft Windows and Office applications.
* Must possess the ability to quickly learn corporate databases.
* On-call 24x7 on a rotational basis, on stand-by, call out, dispatch, and overtime are required as dictated by the business.
* A valid driver’s license
* Sit, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and crawl; lift 50 lbs.; works in all weather conditions

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of relevant job experience
* Attention to detail with good organizational capabilities.
* Ability to prioritize with good time management skills
